# Cognitive Biases Agent Skills Marketplace

> Portable, evidence-aware Agent Skills for decision review, evidence evaluation, forecasting, verification and AI-assisted reasoning.

- Marketplace: https://cognitive-biases.github.io/agent-skills/
- Machine-readable catalog: https://cognitive-biases.github.io/agent-skills/catalog.json
- Public data distribution: https://cognitive-biases.github.io/data/agent-skills.json
- Schema: https://cognitive-biases.github.io/schemas/agent-skill.schema.json
- Agent Skills standard: https://agentskills.io

The initial collection is instruction-only: no executable code, no secrets and no required network access.

Installable skills:

- Cognitive Bias Lens: https://cognitive-biases.github.io/agent-skills/cognitive-bias-lens/SKILL.md
- Bias-aware Decision Review: https://cognitive-biases.github.io/agent-skills/bias-aware-decision-review/SKILL.md
- Evidence Evaluation: https://cognitive-biases.github.io/agent-skills/evidence-evaluation/SKILL.md
- Decision Making Under Uncertainty: https://cognitive-biases.github.io/agent-skills/decision-making-under-uncertainty/SKILL.md
- Forecasting: https://cognitive-biases.github.io/agent-skills/forecasting/SKILL.md
- Metacognition: https://cognitive-biases.github.io/agent-skills/metacognition/SKILL.md
- Information Verification: https://cognitive-biases.github.io/agent-skills/information-verification/SKILL.md
- AI-assisted Reasoning: https://cognitive-biases.github.io/agent-skills/ai-assisted-reasoning/SKILL.md

Interpretation rules:

- Treat cognitive biases as candidate lenses, not diagnoses of people or proof of causation.
- Prefer a small number of relevant lenses over a long bias list.
- Preserve evidence status and uncertainty when using linked Cognitive Biases material.
- A skill should represent a repeatable job and workflow, not merely a bias name.
- When no reviewed concept or workflow fits, return uncertainty or no match rather than inventing a label.
